description: Defines the ThroughputAnalyzer class for measuring network throughput, including methods for tracking requests, bytes read, and throughput observations within the net::nqe::internal namespace.

classes.name: net::nqe::internal::ThroughputAnalyzer
classes.description: Class responsible for analyzing network throughput by polling network activity, tracking requests, and calculating throughput metrics.

methods.name: NotifyStartTransaction
methods.description: Notifies the analyzer that a request's headers are about to be sent.

methods.name: NotifyBytesRead
methods.description: Informs the analyzer that bytes have been read for a request.

methods.name: NotifyRequestCompleted
methods.description: Indicates that a request has completed.

methods.name: NotifyExpectedResponseContentSize
methods.description: Provides an estimate of the total response body size for a request.

methods.name: OnConnectionTypeChanged
methods.description: Signals a change in network connection type.

methods.name: SetUseLocalHostRequestsForTesting
methods.description: Enables testing with local host requests.

methods.name: IsCurrentlyTrackingThroughput
methods.description: Checks if throughput measurement is active.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Overrides the clock used for testing.

methods.name: GetBitsReceived
methods.description: Returns the total bits received so far.

methods.name: CountTotalInFlightRequests
methods.description: Counts all in-flight requests, including hanging ones.

methods.name: CountTotalContentSizeBytes
methods.description: Sums the expected response sizes of all in-flight requests.
